title: Pedersen commitments over an abstract group backend
description: Parametric scheme proof. Backend operations must refine a scalar-field module; hiding requires fresh uniform blinding and a generator H. Binding is a reduction with an explicit discrete-log probability bound. Probabilities use finite uniform random tapes. No concrete curve, RNG, setup, constant-time, or asymptotic complexity proof.

claims.name: refinement
claims.description: The extracted Rust commitment computes m • G + r • H under explicit backend laws.
claims.statement: ∀ (F G : Type) [Field F] [AddCommGroup G] [Module F G] [DecidableEq G] (ops : verified_pedersen.Group G F), Pedersen.BackendLaws ops → ∀ (g h : G) (m r : F), verified_pedersen.commit ops g h m r = Aeneas.Std.RustM.ok (Pedersen.commit g h m r)

claims.name: correctness
claims.description: An honest opening is accepted by the extracted Rust verifier.
claims.statement: ∀ (F G : Type) [Field F] [AddCommGroup G] [Module F G] [DecidableEq G] (ops : verified_pedersen.Group G F), Pedersen.BackendLaws ops → ∀ (g h : G) (m r : F), verified_pedersen.verify ops g h m r (Pedersen.commit g h m r) = Aeneas.Std.RustM.ok true

claims.name: perfect_hiding
claims.description: Uniform fresh blinding yields exactly equal commitment distributions for any two messages; H spans the group.
claims.statement: ∀ (F G : Type) [Field F] [AddCommGroup G] [Module F G] [Fintype F] [DecidableEq G] (ops : verified_pedersen.Group G F), Pedersen.BackendLaws ops → ∀ (g h : G), Function.Surjective (fun r : F => r • h) → ∀ (m₀ m₁ : F) (c : G), Pedersen.probability (fun r : F => verified_pedersen.commit ops g h m₀ r = Aeneas.Std.RustM.ok c) = Pedersen.probability (fun r : F => verified_pedersen.commit ops g h m₁ r = Aeneas.Std.RustM.ok c)

claims.name: binding_reduction
claims.description: Two accepted openings for distinct messages give the discrete logarithm of H to base G.
claims.statement: ∀ (F G : Type) [Field F] [AddCommGroup G] [Module F G] [DecidableEq G] (ops : verified_pedersen.Group G F), Pedersen.BackendLaws ops → ∀ (g h : G), Function.Injective (fun x : F => x • g) → ∀ (o : Pedersen.Opening F), Pedersen.RustBindingWin ops g h o → Pedersen.extractLog o • g = h

claims.name: binding_bound
claims.description: The binding-break probability is bounded by the supplied discrete-log success bound for the explicit reduction, including randomized challenges.
claims.statement: ∀ (F G : Type) [Field F] [AddCommGroup G] [Module F G] [DecidableEq G] (ops : verified_pedersen.Group G F), Pedersen.BackendLaws ops → ∀ (Ω : Type) [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω] (g : G), Function.Injective (fun x : F => x • g) → ∀ (challenge : Ω → G) (attack : Ω → Pedersen.Opening F) (ε : ℚ), Pedersen.probability (fun ω => Pedersen.extractLog (attack ω) • g = challenge ω) ≤ ε → Pedersen.probability (fun ω => Pedersen.RustBindingWin ops g (challenge ω) (attack ω)) ≤ ε
